_about: Instagram location tags for OKST posts. id is a Facebook Page ID that Instagram accepted as location_id (each one checked with an unpublished container on 2026-10-20). A post opts in with <base>.location.json = {"key": "<venue key>"}. Add a venue only after checking its id with: doppler run -p okst -c dev -- .venv\Scripts\python ig_publish.py --check-location <id>. Instagram rejects short ids and most new style profile ids; long place ids from Instagram place search (Apify apify/instagram-search-scraper, searchType place) usually pass.
